g.text: fault-monitor [Container: Quarkus] — one state machine per zone

text.tspan: No edge from here into SUSPECT or CONFIRMED:
missing data is not evidence of a fault

g.text: latched — the only way out is service

text.tspan: Supervisor has degraded the zone, trimmed
the five healthy dampers, raised the fan
Neither state has an edge back to HEALTHY.
Compensation raises the shared fan and trims the
five healthy dampers, so the split pushes air into
the faulted room and the residual shrinks: the
response destroys the signal that found the fault.
A monitor that believed the shrinking residual
would clear a damper still frozen at 0.15.
Hence the latch, and the per-room damper
S = max(0, S + r - k), k = 30 ppm, rises above
the suspicion threshold 0.6 h = 90 ppm — below h,
so suspicion is cheap and reversible
S has decayed back to zero for three
consecutive cycles — the one recovery edge,
and the one CONFIRMED deliberately lacks
S stays above h = 150 ppm (5 sigma) for TWO
consecutive cycles, not one: the margin R-3 needs
comes from persistence, and one extra cycle costs
one minute of R-1's fifteen. Then the classifier
decides from fan power, common mode and
repaired before compensation, or stuck shut
WARMUP, never into SUSPECT or CONFIRMED

g.text: no such edge: a shrinking residual is not a repair
